notes: Validation examples for interactive plan review and its boundary with plan authoring. Copy evals/files/ into a scratch repository root before running a case. Cases marked 'with-record' use docs/plans/order-export-review.md; the others delete it first. Multi-turn cases state the conversation so far in the prompt.

evals.name: start-review-builds-queue
evals.prompt: Review docs/plans/order-export.md with me. I want to understand and challenge the design before we build it.
evals.expected_output: Reads the plan and research, shows a grouped question queue, creates a linked review record, and asks only the first question with context, tradeoffs, and a recommendation.
expectations: Reads the plan and the linked research report before asking any question
Shows the initial queue grouped by topic with a total count
The first question message starts with 'Question 1/N — <topic>' and contains exactly one question
The question gives context, options with tradeoffs, and an explicit recommendation
Does not ask for the maximum rows per export; resolves it from config/exports.json as evidence
Flags that the 24-hour link expiry assumption contradicts downloadLinkTtlMinutes in config/exports.json instead of asking the user to guess
Queues at least one operational failure-mode question, such as queue redelivery during an export or unstable paging on createdAt
Creates docs/plans/order-export-review.md with the queue, statuses, and current position, and adds a 'Review record:' link to the plan
Changes no files outside docs/plans/ and writes no code

evals.name: clarification-does-not-advance
evals.prompt: Continuing the review at Question 3/6 (Q-03, redelivery). Before I decide: what actually happens today if the worker crashes after uploading half the file?
evals.expected_output: Answers the follow-up within Q-03 using the research evidence, keeps the position at 3/6, and asks for the Q-03 decision again.
expectations: Keeps the header at 'Question 3/6 — Failure modes'; M does not advance
Uses the research evidence of at-least-once redelivery after 5 minutes to explain the partial or duplicate object
Keeps Q-03 in status discussing; nothing is marked decided
Ends by returning to the Q-03 decision with a recommendation, not by asking Q-04

evals.name: new-decision-is-queued
evals.prompt: Q-03: go with your idempotent-write recommendation. That also makes me wonder whether we need to cap how many exports a customer can run at once.
evals.expected_output: Settles Q-03, updates the plan, adds a separate concurrency-cap question, announces the new total, and records the queue change.
expectations: Marks Q-03 decided as an explicitly accepted recommendation, with rationale, in the review record
Updates the affected plan sections (design, reliability, steps, and any affected acceptance scenario) and labels the decision as the user's
Adds the concurrency cap as a new question with a new stable ID instead of discussing it inside Q-03
Announces in one line that N increased to 7 and why
Records the addition under Queue changes
The next question shown is numbered 4/7

evals.name: defer-stays-visible
evals.prompt: Q-03 needs input from the platform team. Park it and keep going.
evals.expected_output: Marks Q-03 deferred without resolving it, keeps it in the count, records why, and moves to Q-04.
expectations: Sets Q-03 to deferred in the record, with the reason and what it blocks
N stays 6; the deferred question is not counted as resolved
The next question is 'Question 4/6 — Data' about stable paging
Does not write a decision for Q-03 into the plan; keeps the redelivery concern listed as open

evals.name: ambiguous-reply-is-not-a-decision
evals.expected_output: Does not mark Q-03 decided; asks in one line whether to accept the recommendation or defer it.
expectations: Does not mark Q-03 decided or edit the plan as if it were
Asks briefly whether the user accepts the recommendation or wants Q-03 deferred
Does not invent a decision or rationale

evals.name: resume-from-record
evals.prompt: New session. Let's continue the order export plan review.
evals.expected_output: Reads the review record and plan, reports the position and prior decisions, and continues with Question 3/6 instead of restarting.
expectations: Finds and reads docs/plans/order-export-review.md before asking anything
Briefly reports the decided questions Q-01 and Q-02 and the current position
Continues with 'Question 3/6 — Failure modes' and does not re-ask Q-01 or Q-02
Notices if the plan text disagrees with recorded decisions (for example AC-02 still says all orders while Q-01 decided 24 months) and reconciles it

evals.name: completion-keeps-authorization-separate
evals.prompt: Assume Q-03 to Q-05 are decided as you recommended and I agreed AC-01..AC-03 as revised in Q-06. Looks good, wrap up the review.
evals.expected_output: Marks the review complete and summarizes decisions, deferred items, assumptions, test agreement, authorization not given, readiness, and the next prompt, without implementing.
expectations: Sets the record's review status to complete
Summarizes decisions, separating the user's own decisions from accepted recommendations
Records test agreement as agreed for the AC scenarios
States implementation authorization as not given; 'looks good' is not treated as authorization
Gives a readiness verdict and the next prompt, such as the implementation handoff
Writes no code and runs no implementation

evals.name: authorization-mid-review-hands-off
evals.expected_output: Records the authorization and its scope, asks whether to defer or finish the open questions, and hands off instead of coding inside the review.
expectations: Records implementation authorization as given, with scope and date, in the record and plan
Lists the questions still pending or discussing and asks whether to defer them or finish them first
Hands off through plan-execution or the handoff prompt rather than writing code inside the review

evals.name: annotations-stay-in-authoring-mode
evals.prompt: I added a few notes to docs/plans/order-export.md. Address all the notes and update the document. Don't implement yet.
evals.expected_output: Revises the plan from the annotations in authoring mode without starting an interactive question queue.
expectations: Revises the plan coherently from the notes
Does not start a question queue or show 'Question M/N'
Does not create a review record
Writes no code
evals.setup: Before running, add an inline note to the plan under Assumptions, for example '> NOTE: a retry must never produce a second file for the same export.'
